s: Time-triggered job firing with missed-run policies and concurrency guards - humble but everywhere.
w: Cron expressions define schedules; scheduler instances coordinate via locks/leadership ensuring single-fire per tick. Missed-run policies decide skip-vs-run-immediately-after-downtime; overlapping-run guards prevent pileups when jobs exceed intervals. Timezone/DST edges handled explicitly (UTC recommended internally).
use: Nightly report generations and digest emails
avoid: Dynamic per-user schedules at scale (quartz-style stores or workflow timers)
pits: Double-fire during leader failover - idempotency keys per schedule-tick
DST ambiguity double-runs - UTC internally always
tips: Pair with distributed_lock answer for multi-instance correctness
